name: Malchus
overview: Malchus was the servant of the high priest who was wounded during Jesus' arrest when Peter impulsively cut off his ear. The Gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John each record this event, highlighting Peter's defense of Jesus by drawing a sword and striking Malchus. Importantly, Luke records Jesus' compassionate response as He healed Malchus' ear, demonstrating His power and mercy even in the midst of His own suffering.
